purpose: Bind native-4K temporal shimmer/LOD evidence to the same final-pixel display-transfer and MSAA-resolve contract as the still packet. This contract awards zero Visual Fidelity points and remains PENDING_UNITY_RUNTIME until a real Unity 6000.3.0f1 session verifies the target state.

visualFidelityRiskMapping.risk: A shader copy, wrong sRGB state, or secondary resolve can change thin-edge contrast and shimmer between frames and invalidate temporal judgment.
Temporal frames must use the same exposure/display transfer as hero/oblique/grazing stills or review comparisons are not colorimetrically coherent.
Post-tonemap resampling can soften or alter high-frequency texture evidence at native 100% scale.

failureInjection: Reintroduce Graphics.Blit(msaaTarget, resolvedTarget) in QualityBlockTemporalStabilityCapture and require config validation to fail.
Set bindMS=true on a formal QATemporal target and require Camera.onPreCull to fail before the frame can be sealed.
Set the temporal target sRGB state false and require runtime validation to fail.
Enable dynamic resolution on MainCamera and require runtime validation to fail.
Disable or duplicate QualityBlockFilmicTonmap on MainCamera and require runtime validation to fail.
